Form3 | Account-to-Account (A2A) Payments Platform

CLOUD-NATIVE INFRASTRUCTURE

# A Global Account-to-Account Financial Fabric

Every payment tells a story. Behind each transaction there is a person, business, or moment that really matters.

Form3 is a world-leading account-to-account payments platform trusted by banks and fintechs to deliver resilient, real-time payment experiences for their customers at scale.

ARCHITECTURE

## Powering Payments Your Customers Rely On

Payments cannot afford to fail. Our cloud-native financial fabric simplifies the complexity of payment infrastructure to keep payments moving and enable you to deliver the outcomes that matter to your customers.

Move money across multiple regions, payment networks, and asset types with speed, resilience and control.

GLOBAL REACH

## Payments Infrastructure Built for Global Scale

We operate a cloud-native API that delivers real-time payment processing and continuous availability. The platform replaces fragmented legacy architectures with a unified system that supports high-volume transaction processing at scale.

Delivered as a managed service, it removes the need for banks and fintechs to build, run, and maintain their own complex payments infrastructure. This reduces operational cost, lowers risk, and eliminates the overhead associated with managing multiple interconnected systems.

A single, scheme-agnostic API provides access to payment schemes across the UK, Europe, and the US, simplifying expansion into new markets. Following a single integration, services are delivered via regional infrastructure to ensure data remains within each jurisdiction and meets regulatory requirements.

properties.description:
Form3 develop payment technology. We offer a fully managed, payment technology platform for Financial Institutions as-a-Service.

Our vision is to be the worlds most trusted provider of payment technology.

We design, build and run the technology that powers the future of payments.

Historically, banking leaders believed that infrastructure technologies were an asset for their financial institution because they were managed locally and could be customised. Form3 is changing this model and offering payments infrastructure as a service. A fully cloud native platform that is fully managed to lower costs across operations, infrastructure, security, upgrades, and change management.

Form3 has proven that there is a cheaper, simpler, and more efficient way for FI's to handle large payment volumes and scale dynamically without a heavy infrastructure burden. 

We enable FI’s to benefit from the flexibility, business agility and speed to market that an API-first platform brings along with embedded services that ensure they are always future-ready.

Form3 work with regulated financial institutions including large Enterprise banks and digital challenger banks including Lloyds Banking Group, Ebury, LHV, PPS, N26, Square, Aion Bank and others.
